Looking at each task, I need to construct qlang queries based on the documentation provided.

Let me work through each one:

**R1:** Filter users with active=true, address exists (not null), and city="berlin" (case-insensitive), extract names, sort.

**R2:** Extract ages from users, filter non-null values, compute average, round to 2 decimals.

**R3:** Filter orders with status="paid", group by customer, sum qty*price for each order's items, round totals to 2 decimals.

**R4:** Filter issues with state="open", group by assignee login (null/missing becomes "unassigned"), count each group.

**R5:** Filter issues with state="open", sort by comments descending then number ascending, take first 3, extract numbers.

**R6:** Merge dependencies and devDependencies, find packages with versions starting with "^", get distinct package names, sort.

**R7:** Parse log lines, group by path and status, filter status >= 500, extract distinct paths, sort.

**R8:** Parse log lines, filter GET requests, extract duration (remove "ms"), compute average, round to integer.

**R9:** Parse CSV, skip header and empty salaries, group by dept, compute average salary per dept, round to 1 decimal.

**R10:** Parse CSV, skip header, extract skills column, split by ";", lowercase all, get distinct, sort.

**R11:** Parse env file, skip blanks and comments, filter "DB_" prefix lines, extract key/value (split at first "="), trim, map to object.

**R12:** Get enabled services, build URL from protocol/host/port (default 80), return array of {name, url} objects sorted by name.

**R13:** Compute sum of purchase amounts (0 for null), count distinct users in purchases, check if any event type is "refund" (case-insensitive).

**R14:** Lowercase all strings, group and count, filter count > 1, extract keys as strings, sort.

R1: `/ | filter ~((and (eq /active true) (/address/city | lower | eq "berlin")) !| false) | * /name | sort`

R2: `/ | * (at :age) | filter ~(ne null /) | avg | round 2`

R3: `/ | filter ~(eq /status "paid") | groupBy /customer | * (reduce 0 ~(add (/items | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum))) | * (round 2)`

R4: `/ | filter ~(eq /state "open") | groupBy ~(if (ne null /assignee) (/assignee/login | keyword) (keyword "unassigned")) | * count`

R5: `/ | filter ~(eq /state "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number`

R6: `(at :dependencies) | unionOf (at :devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | distinct | sort | * (keyword)`

R7: `/ | lines | * (split " " | {path: /2 status: (/3 | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) | * /path | distinct | sort`

R8: `/ | lines | * (split " " | [/1 /4]) | filter ~(eq /0 "GET") | * (/1 | split "m" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0`

R9: `/ | lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {dept: /1 salary: ((/2 | parseJson) !| null)}) | filter ~(ne null /salary) | groupBy /dept | * (map /salary | avg) | * (round 1)`

R10: `/ | lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3) | filter ~(ne "" /) | * (split ";" | * (lower)) | flat | distinct | sort`

R11: `/ | lines | filter ~(and (ne "" /) (and (not (startsWith "#")) (startsWith "DB_"))) | * (split "=" | [(/0 | drop 3 | lower | trim | keyword) ((drop 1 | join "=") | trim)]) | tag ::map`

R12: `/services | entries | filter ~(eq true (/1 | at :enabled)) | * ({name: (/0 | keyword) url: (/1 | {protocol: /protocol host: /host port: (at :port | coalesce 80)} | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (/port | print)] | join "")}) | sort ~/name`

R13: `/ | :p (filter ~(eq "purchase" /type)) | {total: (p | * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) users: (p | * /user | distinct | count) hasRefund: (any ~(eq "refund" (/type | lower)))}`

R14: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * (lower) | groupBy ~ | * count | filter ~(gt 1 /) | keys | * (keyword) | sort`
